name: port_state_update
note: per-port state machine for the C-brick and R-brick link ports: on a remote-power-OK change it sets the software-LED bit and the second-expander bit and moves the state from 3 to 4, or clears both and returns to 3; a link-bit change moves 4 and 5; software/firmware/l1/power-up-reads-restart-and-polling.md section 5; read ffe504dc-ffe507c6

name: port_read_and_update
note: takes the port lock, reads PORT CONTROL once, shifts the nibble for the high port and calls the port state routine with the remote-power bit as the changed mask; read ffe509a4-ffe50ab0

name: port_enable
note: sets the port's local-power-OK output bit (or, for a record with the high flag, the second expander) and raises the state to 3; read ffe500fc-ffe5020e

name: port_nibble_clear
note: clears one bit of the port's nibble in PORT CONTROL, translating the mask for the record's layout flag and shifting it for the high nibble; read ffe4fe58-ffe4feea

name: port_nibble_set
note: sets one bit of the port's nibble in PORT CONTROL, the counterpart of the clear routine; read ffe4feec-ffe4ff7e

name: port_second_expander_set
note: sets (or, with the record flag, clears) the port's mask in its second expander; BEDROCK CNTL 1 bit 2 or 3 on the C-brick, WIDGET PRESENT on the R-brick; read ffe50084-ffe500fa

name: port_second_expander_clear
note: the opposite write of the second-expander routine; read ffe50210-ffe50286

name: supply_state
note: counts the supplies with an enable bit and those whose shadow bit reads on; returns 1 when all are on, -1 when some are and 0 when none are; the release predicate and the power-state test of every L1 brick; read ffe4c6ac-ffe4c768

name: supply_state
note: the Origin 300 copy of the supply-state routine, instruction-identical to the package 0 routine with addresses masked; read ffe4c2fc-ffe4c3b8

name: ibrick_family_reset_hold
note: reset hold for letters I, P, X, Y, N and &: clears bits 0, 1 and 3 of each registered XBridge control expander and clears its released byte; software/firmware/l1/power-reset-ibrick-rbrick.md; read ffe47ddc-ffe47e6c

name: ibrick_family_reset_release
note: reset release for letters I, P, X, Y, N and &: computes the strap bits by letter, writes them, and when a supply is on raises bits 1 and 3 and then bit 0 ten ticks apart; read ffe48370-ffe48672

name: rbrick_reset_hold_one
note: holds one router: ROUTER CONTROL bits 0, 2 and 3 := 1, 0, 0 and POWER CONTROL bit 3 cleared; read ffe49f88-ffe49fdc

name: rbrick_reset_hold
note: R-brick reset-hold hook: applies the one-router hold to every registered router record; read ffe49fe0-ffe4a05e

name: rbrick_reset_release_one
note: releases one router: validates the role nibble (0xc, 0xe or 0xf, else 0xf), writes it to ROUTER CONTROL bits 7:4, and when a supply is on sets POWER CONTROL bit 3 and steps ROUTER CONTROL bits 0, 2 and 3 through 9, 0xd, 0xc ten ticks apart; read ffe4a060-ffe4a1b2

name: rbrick_reset_release
note: R-brick reset-release hook: applies the one-router release to every registered router record; read ffe4a1b4-ffe4a232

name: cbrick_reset_release
